name: Water Barrier tags the champion to prevent all but 1 of the next damage
notes: Water Barrier's element is WATER, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WATER champion (Spirit of Water) to unlock element access. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 3-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window. The effect is applied as a WATER_BARRIER turn-effect tag on the champion; only the tag application is covered here, not the actual prevention math (which requires a subsequent damage instance to observe and is out of scope).

rulesClauses: The next time damage would be dealt to your champion this turn, prevent all but 1 of that damage.
